make_decision.description: Answer a yes/no question about something, with how likely the answer is to be yes.

mock_response.question: Is this email asking for a refund?

make_decision.name: make_decision

parameters.description: The yes/no question to answer, in your own words. For example: 'Is this email asking for a refund?'
parameters.name: question

parameters.description: The text or data the question is about: an email body, a support ticket, a row from a sheet.
parameters.name: about

parameters.description: How likely it has to be before the answer reads 'yes'. A number from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.5.
parameters.name: threshold

description: Connect TypeSafe so your workflows can make judgment calls: deciding what something is, not just what it says.
